theorem_summary.name: Support-local witnesses are necessary for prefix-typed append-only RUP-CDCL
theorem_summary.measured_object: typed append-only RUP-CDCL trace without support-local auxiliary witnesses
theorem_summary.conclusion: public formula-label typing and append-only RUP checking do not certify completion-local auxiliary support without an additional support-local witness or equivalent intrinsic invariant
